spy.name: Loop
spy.take: They sell an earplug on lifestyle, never on specs. Concerts, restaurants, focus. Watch how they show the problem (noise) before the product exists on screen.
spy.apply: Same move for the range: lead with the wince, the flinch, the ringing afterward. Product enters late.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Raycon
spy.take: Highest volume of creator-read earbud ads on Meta. Every one opens on a face and a claim in the first two seconds.
spy.apply: Study the first 2s only. Write down 10 of their openers, then rewrite each one for hearing protection.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: SITKA Gear
spy.note: Lifestyle content around hunting we have not tapped into
spy.take: Cinematic hunting lifestyle. Glassing, packing in, cold mornings. Product is worn, never pitched.
spy.apply: This is the gap in our library. Shoot the hunt, not the earbud. Let the product be incidental to a real morning in the field.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: KUIU
spy.note: Lifestyle content around hunting we have not tapped into
spy.take: Same lane as SITKA but tighter edits and more first-person POV. Strong use of real terrain and weather.
spy.apply: POV walking in, POV glassing, POV the moment you hear something. That is our audio angle with a KUIU shell.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Dr. Squatch
spy.note: More fun / comedic style we have barely tested
spy.take: Comedy as the hook, product as the punchline. They get away with absurd openers because the payoff is a real benefit.
spy.apply: We have almost no comedic Ravine content. One joke premise about not hearing your wife, then the 4X passthrough saves you.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: The Ridge
spy.note: 9-figure brand selling wallets, same concepts apply
spy.take: They made a boring category exciting with demo-first edits and hard product cuts. Enormous volume of format tests.
spy.apply: Ravine is also a boring category on paper. Copy their demo cadence: show it, break it, prove it, repeat.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Mars Men
spy.note: Sell to men at crazy scale
spy.take: Almost every ad is a partnership post from a creator account, not the brand. That is whitelisting at scale.
spy.apply: Look at how many different faces run the same script. That is the model we are building toward.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Comfrt
spy.note: Obvious one, they crush it with UGC
spy.take: Enormous UGC volume, very plain filming. Proof that production value is not the constraint.
spy.apply: Nobody here should be blocked on gear. Their winners are shot on a phone in a bedroom.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Houdini Holster
spy.take: Concealed carry demo ads. Heavy on the in-use reveal and the objection-handling comment reply format.
spy.apply: Closest thing to our audience on this list. Their objections are our objections.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: 2Tactic
spy.note: Sells to similar demographics, what works there likely works for us
spy.take: Tactical carry gear to the same 35-65 male buyer we are chasing.
spy.apply: Steal their audience framing, not their product angle. Note: search also returns Forged in the Field, check the advertiser name on each card.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Condition 1 Cases
spy.take: Rugged-gear torture tests. Abuse the product on camera, let the durability sell itself.
spy.apply: Ravine is IPX5 with a lifetime warranty option. A torture test is a format we have never shot.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Undrdog
spy.note: Really effective ads targeting men (demo ad)
spy.take: Demo-led ads aimed squarely at men.
spy.apply: Heads up before you dig in: three different advertisers share this name (UndrDog, UndrDog Hemp, UNDRDOG ATHLETIX). Confirm with Chris which one he meant.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Resilia
spy.take: AI-animated explainer ads. Useful purely as a format study.
spy.apply: Worth watching for the animation technique. Note: this search is noisy with supplement advertisers, filter to the Resilia advertiser.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Seranova
spy.take: Creator-led UGC, mostly partnership posts running through individual accounts.
spy.apply: Study the whitelisting pattern more than the creative. Note: search is heavy with unrelated advertisers.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build

spy.name: Smooche
spy.note: Really good with solution-aware audience targeting
spy.take: They speak to someone who already knows they have the problem and is shopping for the fix.
spy.apply: Our solution-aware buyer is the guy who already has ringing ears. Write to him directly, skip the education.
spy.source: Curated list (Chris), Sept build
